scope: Temporary before/after comparison of the prior local implementation with the completed simulation/rendering and Flight-policy extraction; not native pixels or human gameplay certification. Duplicate baseline source was removed after the comparison.

canvas.assertions: Every step compares the update return value and complete save; sampled frames compare canvas calls and property values. JSDOM proxy contexts; Math.random fixed at 0.5 for cosmetic effects.

flight.assertions: Every step compares return value and complete durable state under declared steering/boost/camera/contract/ship/navigation/route input.

notes: The temporary comparison covers the extraction stage. Later counter/lifecycle/contract hardening and renderer-retention cleanup are covered by final regressions. The final-tree digest is a reference, not the digest of the temporary comparison harness.
